note: UK-eligible Eureka calls only. A call is included only when the United Kingdom is a listed participating country, so UK applicants can access national funding. Funding value is left blank unless Eureka publishes a single call-level amount. Refresh by re-pulling from the Eureka site (Cloudflare-protected, no public API) and updating this file.

calls.title: CELTIC-NEXT call for projects – Autumn 2026
calls.summary: CELTIC-NEXT is the Eureka Cluster for next-generation communications and ICT. This call funds collaborative R&D projects in advanced networking, connectivity and digital technologies, delivered through participating national funding agencies.

calls.title: Eurogia2030 – Call 31
calls.summary: Eurogia2030 is the Eureka Cluster for low-carbon energy. This call funds collaborative R&D projects developing low-carbon technologies that reduce climate change and support sustainable growth.

calls.title: ITEA call for projects 2026
calls.summary: ITEA is the Eureka Cluster for software innovation. This call funds collaborative R&D projects in software-intensive systems and services across industry sectors.

calls.title: 5th Innowwide call for market feasibility projects – Autumn 2026
calls.summary: Innowwide funds market feasibility studies for innovative SMEs exploring business opportunities in the Americas, Africa, Asia or Oceania. Successful applicants receive a lump sum of €60,000.

calls.title: Globalstars call with Japan 2026
calls.summary: A Globalstars call enabling organisations from Eureka countries to run collaborative R&D projects with partners in Japan, across most technology areas with a civilian purpose.

calls.title: Xecs Call 6 – 2026
calls.summary: Xecs is the Eureka Cluster for electronic components and systems. This call funds collaborative R&D projects in electronics, from materials and devices to systems and applications.

calls.title: SMART Call 10 – 2026
calls.summary: SMART is the Eureka Cluster for advanced manufacturing. This bottom-up call funds collaborative R&D projects aligned with SMART's technology roadmap for smart, sustainable manufacturing.

calls.title: Open call for Network Projects applications
calls.summary: A rolling, bottom-up call for international collaborative R&D projects in any technology area with a civilian purpose. Projects need a consortium of at least two organisations from two participating countries.

calls.title: Eurostars Call 12 for projects – deadline March 2027
calls.summary: Eurostars supports R&D-performing SMEs leading international collaborative innovation projects. Funding is provided by national agencies in participating countries; UK participation is administered by Innovate UK.
